description: Where a Lexicon-style registry keeps languages, mappings and publication metadata. The resolver, fetcher and run tools read every repository path, SSM name and default from this file; pass --layout to use another registry.

transformRegistry.description: Transform's own mapping registry, checked before publishedRegistry. Schema-free v2 runs resolve registered versions here first and fall back to Lexicon's published registry while the Transform stack's lexiconMappingFallback is true. The validation scripts still resolve through publishedRegistry.

devDeploy.description: The registry repository's documented DEV deploy path. Lexicon has no workflow_dispatch: its DEV CI/CD workflow runs on pull_request only and deploys the PR's registry (DEPLOY_LEXICON_ONLY=true, just deploy), replacing the shared DEV registry (latest-PR-wins). Republishing a pinned candidate is a full re-run of the newest run of that workflow for the pinned head SHA.

node.reason: tsx (the materialize command) needs Node.js 18+; CI uses 22.18. Older supported majors work but npm may print EBADENGINE warnings, so they are warned about, not blocked.
